# A basis balance stated on the fund units a purchase brought in.
#
# 1.000 FUNDX is bought for 100.00 CAD, and `cost_basis_balance:` is written on
# the FUNDX split. A fund is a holding with a cost in the book's own currency
# (Q-046), so the split is a cost basis and the stated balance is what is left
# of it — all of it here, the purchase having sold none.
#
# What this fixture produces: one cost basis, 1.00 FUNDX at 100 CAD/FUNDX.
# Two decimal places because the FUNDX commodity divides into 100, whatever
# smallest unit the account is kept to.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_stated_balance_is_checked.py.
2026-01-01 commodity FUNDX
	mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	fullname: "Example Balanced Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Fund
	type: Mutual Fund
	commodity.namespace: "FUND"
	commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	commodity_scu: 1000

2026-01-10 * "Buy fund units"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Fund 1.000 FUNDX
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
		share_price: "100"
		value: "100.00"
		cost_basis_balance: "1.000"
	Assets:Bank -100.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-100.00"
